cohort: 589 pregnant women with term singleton fetuses in cephalic presentation, reactive nonstress tests, PROM of 2-24 h duration, Bishop score <6, and no previous uterine surgery
finding: Vaginal misoprostol induction in term PROM gravidas with unfavorable cervixes was associated with lower cesarean section and higher vaginal delivery rates within 24 h than oxytocin infusion.
mod_finding: Vaginal misoprostol induction in term PROM gravidas with unfavorable cervixes was associated with lower cesarean section and higher vaginal delivery rates within 24 h than oxytocin infusion.
